Ski Tracker & Ski Tracks is an application for all who love snow and winter sports. Useful for skiers and snowboarders. Measure the maximum skiing speed, tracks, distance, mark the slopes on the map and provide full statistics of your winter sports activity.

Inside the app you can activate premium app version, which is extended on many additional and useful functions.

Ski Tracker includes the following features:
- measure and recording the maximum skiing speed
- measurment ski tracks distance, divided into downhill skiing and lifts
- time measure, skiing, lifts and rest
- marking your ski tracks on the map
- monitoring the height above sea level, with recording min. and max. values
- special feature "Fast Ride" to make a separate measurement of maximum speed, time and distance to any section and time
- all data and statistics you can record all day and later view history
- with this app you can take pictures with data on it and share them with friends,
- our idea is - any ski statistics, maps, graph and others data in one app

To use this app do not need a mobile roaming data, just GPS is enough. Remember that the GPS work poorly inside the buildings and can generate wrong data. Sometimes outdoors GPS may need more time to catch the good signal, especially in bad weather conditions.

Snow tracker application can also be used to training cross-country skiing, skitouring, skating, snowboarding, alpine skiing or other sports practiced in the open. This app is useful for experienced professionals, but also novice skiers will have while using it a lot of fun.

With Exa Ski Tracker, you can compare ski sports results with friends, organize sports competitions and other forms of competitive winter sports.
Ski Tracker can also help you navigate on the ski slopes, in finding routes or touch with your friends.

You're going skiing in Zermatt or Chamonix? Or maybe Aspen? Check the weather and instal Ski Tracker app. No matter where you'll be, this app certainly give you a lot of fun and impressions!

ROUVY is the indoor cycling app that lets you ride real routes around the world on your bike.

Combining sport and technology, ROUVY is the #1 software for a realistic and immersive video experience with over 1300 routes around the world to choose from. It enables cyclists of all levels to train, have fun and explore the world from the comfort of their own home. Conquer the Alpe d’Huez, ride through Monument Valley or train for your next cycling event on the virtual route.

Key features
- Ride the world's most iconic routes filmed on high-quality video 
- Over 25,000km of virtual road to explore around the world
- Wide variety of terrains and gradients
- Weekly programme of challenges, special events and group rides
- Training plans
- Avatar customization
- Sync ROUVY with your Strava, Garmin or Wahoo

Start Your Indoor Cycling Journey Today
Download ROUVY for free and unlock a world of cycling possibilities. A subscription is required to access the full range of features. We offer a free trial so you can experience ROUVY firsthand before committing.

Simple Setup
Create an account, connect your compatible trainer via Bluetooth, and follow the on-screen instructions to begin your indoor cycling adventure.
